observation.visible_scene: A dim, warm-lit indoor birthday scene. A round frosted cake sits on a clear glass pedestal stand, densely covered with many thin, multicolored birthday candles, most already burning. At the upper left a person's hand grips a long-reach (barbecue-style) utility lighter with a black handle and red collar; its metal wand reaches over the cake and its small flame is held at the left-side candle cluster. At the right edge of the cake a second thin stick-like ignition tool touches a leaning pink candle, producing a flame there. In the dark background two children's faces are visible watching, a paper poster hangs on the wall, a white cabinet stands at the right, and a matchbox rests on the table beside the cake.
visible_changes: The flames on the candles flicker continuously, changing height, brightness and shape from frame to frame.
The hand and long lighter at the left stay in roughly the same position but make small tremor-like adjustments in angle and grip, keeping the wand tip near the left candle cluster.
The right ignition stick and its flame at the pink candle remain in place, with the flame flickering.
The girl in the background shifts her head so her smiling face becomes more visible in later frames.
The overall count and arrangement of lit candles stays broadly similar across the segment; no clear new-ignition sequence or extinguishing is distinctly visible.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether this excerpt is the beginning or the middle of the candle-lighting process.
What the right-hand stick actually is (a second lighter, a transferred flame, or a sparkler).
Any outcome after the clip ends (e.g., all candles lit, the tools withdrawn).
The cause of the children's expressions or any sound.
uncertain_details: Individual candle-by-candle ignition order cannot be tracked reliably due to flame flicker.
It is unclear whether the slight background framing changes are subject motion or minor camera motion.
The exact material of the candles (wax vs. sparkler type) is not confirmable.
